trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Check the console trophy list for any remaining bronze, silver or gold before marking platinum. The description is a congratulations message; the target here is the other 54 trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Look for Gone Fishing in your story objectives. Play through the mission’s finish and confirm the trophy before moving on. Its chapter placement and replay options are pending.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Use the Chapter 1 completion trophy as your first numbered story checkpoint. Take note of the chapter transition if the unlock does not appear immediately.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Track this as the second chapter milestone. Judge progress by the chapter wrap-up, since the description does not name a specific mission within it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Mark Chapter 3 off when you reach its ending. Check the individual named mission trophies separately, since the list does not place them by chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Log the end of Chapter 4 separately from the finale. The list gives each its own trophy and does not explain how close together they occur.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Keep this gold separate from the numbered chapter checks. Confirm it after the mission the game treats as its finale. The trophy list leaves that mission unnamed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Watch for Breakfast Run by its exact title in the story log. Complete the mission before checking the trophy. The list gives no rank or optional objective.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Match the mission title to The Cartel Heist in your story log. Check for the unlock after the mission ends. The chapter and replay availability are pending.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Look for Child's Play in your mission list. Use the completed mission as your checkpoint. The trophy text gives no ending choice or performance requirement.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Use Headliners as the lookup term in your mission log. Check this trophy after finishing the mission, even if you have already checked the surrounding chapter.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Look specifically for the mission VCIA Takedown. The separate airport-departure trophy has its own condition and can be tracked independently.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Look for the full title Operation Savage Glory. Confirm the mission has registered as complete. The list leaves its position in the campaign open.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Compare against the game’s completion percentage and use any outstanding categories it exposes to guide cleanup. The trophy list gives the 100% target but leaves the checklist behind it open.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Keep a running count of credited stunt completions toward 250. Check what the game credits before relying on repeats. The qualifying stunt types and repeat rules are pending.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Keep one check per activity category as you sample them. Track categories rather than individual venues. The list does not enumerate those categories.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Audit results challenge by challenge and revisit anything below gold. A single lower medal leaves the set incomplete. The source description does not specify scores or range locations.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Keep one win per Top Fun location. Once a venue has credited a win, move to a different venue. The full venue checklist is pending.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Record the event name after each win so you can avoid counting a repeat. Build a list of 20 separate winning results.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Look for Cal’s fishing challenge by name and check the result against Cal. Ordinary fishing sessions have no stated bearing on this unlock. The event location is pending.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Choose an arcade title and play through a completed run. Check whether the game registers completion at the result screen. The list leaves the qualifying games and scores open.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Keep Andy’s missions under one checklist entry and confirm you have reached his last assignment. Starting the strand alone is insufficient. Its opening point is pending.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton’s assignments to their endpoint. If you are tallying stranger strands at the same time, verify any credit in-game. The trophy list doesn’t say which strands overlap.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Check Billy’s quest log for remaining assignments before marking his final mission. The list gives the character to track but leaves the finale’s title and availability open.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Count one entry for each fully wrapped-up stranger storyline. Eight individual missions could belong to fewer than eight strands. The list leaves the eligible strands unnamed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Use Randy as the anchor when reviewing side missions. Tick the trophy once his closing mission is complete. The list leaves the first meeting and mission count open.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Keep Tyrone’s strand on your side-mission list until his closing assignment registers. The exact mission name and access window are pending.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Keep a checklist of meditation spots as you discover them across Leonida. Because the objective calls for every spot, check new locations before repeating visits. Total and access windows are pending.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Tie the attempt to Bret’s objective and verify the animal is credited there. The list gives neither a species nor a hunting location.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Group finds by set and close out missing cards in nearly complete sets first. Track three finished sets instead of three individual pickups. Card locations and set sizes are pending.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Log distinct places where the game credits a WAiNK interaction. Aim for 100 locations and use the count to judge coverage. The activation method and map are pending.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Track credited challenge completions toward 50. Keep this tally separate from your shooting medal audit until the game confirms whether they overlap.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: For this in-game pursuit, verify that your partner is present and the wanted meter has reached four stars before ending the chase. Check the trophy once the heat clears.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Treat the three virtual shop robberies as one continuous attempt with your partner. If the wanted meter clears partway through, start the count over. Eligible shops are pending.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Keep a list of credited vehicle discoveries so you can focus on unfamiliar models. The list gives a target of 100 but leaves the discovery interaction open.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Treat each Combat Focus activation as a fresh attempt. Check whether five takedowns registered before that activation ended. The list leaves the controls and qualifying targets open.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Use VCIA as the search area for the in-game event. Keep this separate from the VCIA Takedown mission. The exact meaning of an unscheduled departure is pending.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Use the Rhino reference to identify the likely in-game context, then wait for a verified trigger. The clue leaves the action, location and conditions open.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Use detection as the pass/fail check during the in-game jewelry-store objective. Treat a detected run as a failed trophy attempt. Eligible stores and detection rules are pending.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Track completed in-game vault jobs and count an attempt only once the escape is credited. Verify how the game handles repeats before counting the same vault twice.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Check for the unlock after the in-game escape is registered. Opening the truck alone covers only part of the stated objective. Event spawn details are pending.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Review any exploration indicators the game provides and make a note of outstanding areas. The list names Leonida as the scope. Region boundaries and total are pending.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Track credited in-game jobs by gang. Two operations for one gang still leave the other gangs unaccounted for. The roster and qualifying operation types are pending.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Start with the named area, Ocean Beach, and look for an in-game cocktail interaction with a view. The specific venue and any timing requirements are pending.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Look for a vehicle showroom in-game and watch for trophy credit during the exit sequence. The phrase “classic style” leaves the required trigger open.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Use Kolt & Associates to identify the bowling alley. The clue leaves the exact bowling input, score and unlock condition pending.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The partnership clue gives you a theme to watch for while playing. The exact characters, event and trigger are pending. Keep the trophy unchecked until it registers.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Watch for credited progress after in-game choices. The clue leaves both eligible decisions and the threshold open, so avoid planning around a specific number.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The wording suggests a retry may matter. The list leaves the event, failure condition and required follow-up open. Wait for an observed trigger before targeting a specific attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Keep this on your cleanup list while exploring. The clue gives no reliable event, location or action to target. A reproducible trigger is pending.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Check for credit after an in-game melee drive-by knockdown. The description singles out melee. Eligible vehicles and input timing are pending.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Track the amount credited from Marked Bills through contacts toward $250,000. Keep the tally separate from your general cash balance. The contact roster is pending.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Treat $100,000 as a cumulative spend target and track credited purchases. The phrase “across all shops” leaves any shop coverage rule open.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Compare owned garages against any property list available in-game and target the gaps. The trophy text requires the full set. The property count and locations are pending.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Check registrations inside Scooter Bros and tally ten credited vehicles. Discovery alone belongs to a separate trophy. App access and eligible vehicles are pending.
